headline: Re-attack the 019 defect cluster with a bounded enforcement design: one narrow fail-open boundary script wired at decomposer 8c only, plus the missing decomposer rules, reviewer pattern-naming, and reviser recipes — every firing condition verified against every file version of all 8 tasks.

clusters.name: spec-epic/content-epic boundary overlap
clusters.detail: The format-defining epic (E001) authored a real content instance ('reference example of a correctly packaged tutorial' in scope + two ACs) duplicating the sibling content epic's (E003) authoring surface. The first review missed it (caught only priority inheritance), the unconditional first revision fixed only that, and the terminal re-review listed the overlap as a minor too late to be fixed. External scorer: 'Epic Boundaries — solid with one minor overlap' → decomposition_quality 4/5. Root cause: decomposer lacks a spec-vs-content boundary rule; detection is stochastic and terminal.

clusters.name: rollout-gate AC gap
clusters.detail: E002's scope names a rollout gate ('feature flag / dashboard config gating for the gallery section') with no acceptance criterion verifying the gated behavior. Step 7 has no rollout-gate coverage rule; review Criterion 6 doesn't name the pattern. Same review-passes-with-unfixed-minors mechanism as cluster A; possible secondary deduction in the scorer's truncated AC-Quality rationale.

clusters.name: prior enforcement-chain blast radius (process defect)
clusters.detail: cand_0001 fixed this same cluster but broke 013/014/016: mechanical findings folded into the first review drive the unconditional revision, so any false positive churns a passing decomposition; its script was verified only against FINAL artifacts while intermediate (post-decompose) states differ on revised tasks. This iteration's design constraint, not a task cluster.

edits.title: Decompose Step 5: spec-vs-content boundary rule + worked example
edits.verified: Trigger (format epic + sibling non-docs content-authoring epic) verified absent from all 7 passing tasks' epic sets; worked example uses a different domain than 019.

edits.title: Decompose Step 7: rollout-gate coverage AC rule
edits.verified: Gate-in-scope-without-AC condition verified unique to 019-E002 across all 8 tasks, all file versions.

edits.title: New bundled script check_decomposition.py (spec-content + gating-ac checks, --self-check)
edits.verified: Self-check 5/5 fixtures; exit 0 zero findings on all 7 passing tasks' final artifacts AND every intermediate version reconstructed from all Write/Edit calls in all 8 transcripts; exactly the 2 target findings on 019; fix loop closed (apply stated fixes → exit 0).

edits.title: Decompose Step 8c: fail-open boundary self-check invocation with dual-path resolution
edits.verified: Invocation snippet executed verbatim in both runtime layouts (double-nested and single-nested); script exits 0 on passing tasks so the only delta is one Bash call printing OK; fail-open on error/unavailability.

edits.title: Review Criterion 3: named spec-vs-content overlap pattern with do-not-flag guidance
edits.verified: No passing task's first or final review lists an overlap-class issue (extracted from all 8 transcripts); no passing task has the trigger structure; negative guidance names the observed near-miss classes.

edits.title: Review Criterion 6: named rollout-gate coverage pattern with do-not-flag guidance
edits.verified: Same transcript extraction; 013 (human-approval gates) and 014 (gate AC present) explicitly protected by the exclusions.

edits.title: Revise Step 2: two named defect classes fixed even when minor
edits.verified: Passing tasks' listed minors (015 HLR, 016 HLR/AI, 017 AI, 018 AI, 020 DAG/Type/AI/Completeness) match neither named class — latitude unchanged.

edits.title: Revise Epic Boundary recipe: spec-epic/content-epic overlap (stub or subsume, never merge)
edits.verified: Keyed to the overlap defect signature, absent from all passing tasks' reviews.

edits.title: Revise AC recipe: missing rollout-gate AC
edits.verified: Keyed to the gate-gap signature, absent from all passing tasks' reviews.

edits.title: SKILL.md description: add 'Use when' (clears seed validation warning)
edits.verified: 305 chars < 1024, third person, same triggers; addresses the warning recorded in rejected.jsonl.

skipped.title: docs-priority derivation enforcement (019-E004 P2 vs Major→P1)
skipped.reason: Scorer's visible feedback explicitly accepts P2 under the docs-exemption rule — zero scored upside, nonzero churn risk.

skipped.title: gate_failure_impact / gated_by completeness check
skipped.reason: Fires on passing case-020's post-decompose state (its first review flagged exactly this); decompose-time fixing would change a passing task's trajectory without verified fix-path equivalence.

skipped.reason: Ambiguous conventions (epic_count may count main-plan only or all epics — 016 has branch files) and cand_0001's rejection is consistent with broad structural checks false-firing; review rubric already covers them by hand.

skipped.title: Reviewer-side script folding / revise-side re-run gate / loop-semantics changes
skipped.reason: The most plausible break mechanism of rejected cand_0001; enforcement stays at the producer (decomposer), fail-open.
